description: Step Streets Locations is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Step Street are steps that were built, instead of a typical roadway, on a mapped street that has a huge grade difference. They were built to avoid very steep roadway and provide access for public use. These steep, block-long, open-air staircases for pedestrians connect two streets at different elevations. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are stairs, roadway, streets, sidewalk, step. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
